projects.title: Assistive Indoor Navigation
projects.subtitle: Vision-language indoor navigation for blind and low-vision users
projects.outcome: Accepted at CVPR 2026 and IISWC 2026; UMBC IRB Protocol #1743 (InVLM)
projects.summary: AI-powered indoor navigation using vision-language reasoning, floor-plan parsing, and on-device multimodal workloads to support blind and low-vision users.
highlights: Principal Investigator, UMBC IRB Protocol #1743 — InVLM: VLM-Based Indoor Navigation System for People with Visual Impairments (Expedited Human-Subjects Research, approved May 2025).
LLM-guided floor-plan parsing for accessible indoor wayfinding (CVPR 2026).
On-device depth-aware multimodal workload characterization for assistive navigation (IISWC 2026).
Designed around accessibility workflows rather than sighted map metaphors.

projects.title: WildfireVLM
projects.subtitle: Vision-language wildfire detection and risk assessment
projects.outcome: Accepted at IGARSS 2026; modular next-day spread preprint on arXiv
projects.summary: Vision-language system for early wildfire detection and risk assessment from satellite imagery, with follow-on work on auditable next-day spread prediction.
highlights: Pairs satellite visual evidence with language-based risk interpretation.
Accepted at IGARSS 2026 (arXiv:2602.13305).
Related modular next-day wildfire spread preprint under submission (arXiv:2609.17763).

projects.title: Claude Code Encyclopedia
projects.subtitle: Searchable Claude Code, Codex and GitHub CLI reference
projects.outcome: Live standalone GitHub Pages app with structured JSON catalog
projects.summary: A searchable reference covering Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI and GitHub CLI in one encyclopedia UI: commands, flags, settings keys, hooks, gh workflows and configuration paths, with OS-aware examples.
highlights: One encyclopedia UI for Claude Code, Codex CLI and GitHub CLI, with family filters and deep links.
GitHub CLI records load from structured JSON so adding a command is a data edit.
OS-aware examples, version awareness, keyboard navigation, and local favorites.

projects.title: ADHD Study Pack
projects.subtitle: Pomodoro workspace for an ADHD attention system
projects.outcome: Live app with Google sync, comfort profiles, and planner tools
projects.summary: A browser-based Pomodoro workspace built around how an ADHD study session actually falls apart: focus dial, Eisenhower triage, week planner, distraction parking, and comfort profiles.
highlights: Eisenhower priority matrix with drag-and-drop triage and focus-time checks.
Week planner with auto-scheduling into free hours; .ics import and export.
Comfort profiles for ADHD, calm/predictable, low vision, easier reading, and screen readers.

projects.title: Medical Image Segmentation
projects.subtitle: Multi-task medical image analysis
projects.outcome: Peer-reviewed papers on label-free microscopy segmentation (2019–2021)
projects.summary: Multi-task deep-learning platform for automated medical image analysis with explicit handling of imbalanced datasets and label-free optical microscopy.
highlights: Segmentation and classification workflows for phase-contrast microscopy.
Designed for imbalanced medical-imaging datasets.
Published results in Turkish Journal of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences and IEEE TIPTEKNO/SIU venues.

projects.title: Vision-Language Medical AI
projects.subtitle: CLIP-based medical vision-language research
projects.outcome: Exploratory CLIP-style medical VLM for zero-shot classification and reporting
projects.summary: Custom CLIP-based architecture for medical imaging with zero-shot classification and report-generation capabilities.
highlights: Explores zero-shot medical-image classification.
Connects medical visual features with language representations.
Bridges medical imaging practice with modern multimodal models.

projects.title: Knowledge Distillation
projects.subtitle: Hint-based model compression
projects.summary: Hint-based knowledge-distillation framework (PURSUhInT) for informative layer clustering, targeting efficient teacher-to-student transfer with strong compression.
highlights: Finds informative hint points via layer clustering for distillation.
Published in Expert Systems with Applications, vol. 213, 119040, 2023.
Targets reduced deployment cost while retaining predictive quality.

projects.title: Graph Autoencoder
projects.subtitle: Residual GNN representation learning
projects.outcome: arXiv preprint and IEEE SIU 2020 papers on residual graph autoencoders
projects.summary: Graph neural-network work using residual connections for representation learning and link prediction on graph-structured data.
highlights: Residual variational graph autoencoders for link prediction.
Representation learning with residual graph autoencoders (arXiv:2105.00695).
IEEE SIU 2020 conference contributions.

projects.title: ML Data Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Scalable preprocessing and feature engineering
projects.outcome: Scalable preprocessing pipeline for high-volume ML workflows
projects.summary: Scalable data-processing pipeline for automated preprocessing and feature engineering on high-volume machine-learning workloads.
highlights: Automates preprocessing and feature-engineering stages.
Designed around high-volume machine-learning data workflows.
Emphasizes reliability and reproducible feature generation.
